import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

backend=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
root=backend.parent/'carebridge-ai'
for name in ('workspace-ai-v14.json','workspace-ai-v15.json'):
    raw=(backend/'data'/name).read_bytes()
    value=json.loads(raw)
    assert value.get('finishedAt')
    assert value['allPassed']==(name=='workspace-ai-v15.json')
    with (root/'evaluation'/name).open('xb') as f:f.write(raw)

    with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=5) as response:return json.load(response)
files=['spec-gpu-v14.json','spec-reference-review-v14.json','backend-contract-spec-v14.json','workspace-ai-v14.json','workspace-ai-v15.json','translation-corpus-v8.json']
